name: IsAnyPointInPoly
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,points,LET(n, ROWS(points), result, REDUCE(FALSE, SEQUENCE(n), LAMBDA(acc,i, LET(point, HSTACK(INDEX(points, i, 1), INDEX(points, i, 2)), inside, {ref}IsPointInPoly(vertices, point), OR(inside, acc)))), result))
comment: Returns TRUE when any row of points lies inside the polygon. Vertices and points are n×2 arrays of (x, y) rows; the last vertex connects to the first. A point on the boundary counts as inside. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
